body:

[Kanjus] I thought costco was always around this price
[conza] So I bought these, 9-12 months ago (when released or a bit after? I can't remember). Big fan of them, and paid, a tiny bit more than this, so I think this is a good deal all things considered.
The battery life imo, leaves a bit to be desired, if you're going to run them all day (10 hours), probably let them charge to 100%, and a wireless charger feels like a bit of a must, personally, I very rarely plug them in. I'm pretty much charging the case daily, every other day.
Excellent noise cancellation for the people on the other end, like running water, street noise etc, and decent for blocking out noise to you, but have found myself turning up the volume.
[welcomeUniverseWorld] Can any active user tell me more about Hearing Test, Hearing Aid and Loud Sound Reduction features? What are these features? And how good are they?
Does it reduce Tinnitus?
[SirFrankGrimes] Does anyone else find that when they eat, their AirPods loosen and sometimes even fall out?
